profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a mathematician who thrives in environments where I can solve challenging problems, contribute, learn, and continue growing as a software professional.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Partnered in creation of an engineering internship / mentorship program which brings diversity to the company through giving opportunities to junior engineers from non traditional backgrounds as well as giving current engineers opportunities for management and mentorship experience.

Built software needed to support the agents and admin experience viewing and editing customer policies. Daily tasks included creating React with Typescript components using React Context for state management and building out RESTful api endpoints in frontend middle layer written with Express in Typescript. Transitioned to backend team and project written in Express with Typescript. Built new infrastructure on top of current architecture and maintained previous functionality with ongoing updates to product needs. 

Continuous collaboration and communication with parallel teams and product. Ongoing support to add full integration tests with Jest and React Testing Library for all major policy pages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned project for building out new authentication page. Full stack project with brand new frontend written in React with Typescript and integration with legacy authentication api. Included adding CSRF token validation, authentication event tracking using Sift and ongoing support for new UI and features.

Built React components with latest React concepts and Redux state management while maintaining and updating legacy components, integrated use of a separate shared component library, contributed to existing and created new documentation, maintaining code coverage on all front end projects (unit and integration tests)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Used Python to conduct research on abnormal galaxies. Worked alongside other students in the REU (Research Experience for Undergrads) program.

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in a 9-month program for women, trans, and nonbinary technologists to develop career skills and work on collaborative projects advancing gender equality in tech.
As a Black History Month initiative, the purpose of this panel is to empower existing and future Black employees at SimpliSafe and highlighting Black experiences in the tech industry

projects.title: Astronomy Website
projects.description: Backend created using Ruby on Rails. Frontend created using JavaScript, Handlebars, Bootstrap, HTML and SASS. Makes use of the variety of NASA APIs; Astronomy Picture of the Day, Mars Rover, Near Earth Objects, NASA Sounds and NASA Patents APIs. Users can view the astronomy picture of the day and save images to favorites list, comment on favorites, view NASA patents and sounds and also browse the mars rover photos by date.

projects.title: Movie Website
projects.description: Full stack web application project. Backend created using Ruby on Rails. Uses SQL database. Frontend created using JavaScript, Handlebars, Bootstrap, HTML and SASS. Users can search for movies, save them to a favorites list and also comment on their favorite movies and see other users comments.
